summary: End-to-end testing of the new Tenant Kiosk multi-step pay flow (/c/surirent/kiosk/huurder) that replaces the old auto-pay PayView. All 11 review scenarios PASS on mobile 393x852 + desktop 1440x900. Backend regression: 21 pass + 2 skipped (kiosk + forgot-pin suites). Real 1 SRD payment via contant fully succeeded through select->method->confirm->paid and returned to refreshed dashboard. OLD bug (single-tap auto-pay) is FIXED — no tk-pay-{id} per-invoice button exists; only the multi-step flow.

PASS — 14 passed, 2 skipped (skip is pre-existing, not introduced).

critical_code_review_comments: TenantKioskLayout.jsx is now 1384 lines — five sub-views (PinpadLogin, Dashboard, TenantPaySelect, TenantPayMethod, TenantPayConfirm, TenantHistoryView) live in one file. Consider extracting each view into /pages/vastgoed/tenant-kiosk/*.jsx for maintainability; the file exceeds the 700-line guideline.

TenantPaySelect+TenantPayMethod+TenantPayConfirm largely duplicate the operator-kiosk PaySelect+MethodSelect+PaymentConfirm logic in KioskLayout.jsx — opportunity to extract a shared <PayFlow/> component or shared hooks to avoid drift between tenant and operator flows on future fixes.

Right card shows 'SALDO' label whether totalDue is >0 or =0. Review spec mentions 'Te betalen/Saldo' switching by state. Currently a static 'SALDO' label with 'U bent volledig bij. Bedankt!' subtitle when zero — works visually but main agent may want to explicitly toggle label text for parity with operator kiosk.

When totalDue is 0 but apt.rent_amount is 7000 (Bharat case), tapping Volgende pre-selects Huur for 7000 SRD even though backend says nothing is owed. This is documented behaviour ('fallback to rent_amount') but could confuse users — consider showing a confirmation banner 'Geen openstaand bedrag — vooruitbetaling?' when totalDue===0.
